methods.name: Peer-Median
methods.skip_reason: insufficient narrow peer set in Robotics & Manufacturing (found 0 same-stage, 0 adjacent-stage, 0 similar-tier; need ≥3)
methods.rationale: 11 same-sector peers exist in Robotics & Manufacturing, but none of the narrow filters (same-stage / adjacent-stage / similar-valuation-tier) yielded ≥3 datapoints. Falling back to all-sector median would be misleading.

data.narrative:
Loombotic operates in Robotics & Manufacturing, a sector populated by 1 public comparable (277810.KQ) and 8 private peers including Divergent, Exotec, Locus Robotics, Generalist AI, and Bedrock Robotics. The company's stage and current valuation are undisclosed, limiting immediate benchmarking precision.

The peer-median method is not applicable here. While 11 same-sector peers exist in Robotics & Manufacturing, the dataset contains insufficient narrow-filter matches—zero companies at the same stage, zero at adjacent stages, and zero in similar valuation tiers. This scarcity means a traditional median approach would lack statistical rigor; an all-sector median would risk misrepresenting Loombotic's position given stage and capital-intensity variation within the universe.

Without triangulation results or disclosed current valuation, no quantitative range can be supported at this time. To enable credible valuation, key uncertainties requiring resolution include: Loombotic's development stage and operating metrics (revenue, unit economics, or deployment scale), a refined peer subset filtered by stage and scale, and comparable transaction multiples or recent rounds from private robotics companies. The single public comparable warrants examination for margin structure and capital efficiency, though cross-border application (277810.KQ) may reflect regional market factors distinct from Loombotic's context.
